name: moneyflow
description: App personal de finanzas: sueldo quincenal, pasajes, suscripciones y gastos, periodo a periodo.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.render-build: npm install && npm run build -w frontend && npm run prisma:generate -w backend
scripts.start: npm run prisma:deploy -w backend && npm run start -w backend
